candidates.name: Developing estates: estate plan approval (Practice Guide 41, supplement 2)
verified_facts: HMLR estate plan approval can be used independently or after estate boundary approval.
The submitted estate plan should show the final layout.
Where estate boundary approval was used, estate layout plans should be based on the same plan.
An approved estate plan or extracts can form the basis of transfer or lease plans, providing continuity through plot sales.
semantic_limits: Estate-plan approval establishes registration workflow consistency; it does not certify planning permission, exact surveyed legal-boundary coordinates or parcel elevation values.

candidates.name: Developing estates: plot sales: transfers and leases (Practice Guide 41, supplement 4)
verified_facts: The guide explains how purchasers can satisfy themselves that a plot and associated rights are within the developer's title.
It separates plot/title evidence from other registration matters such as official searches, charges and restrictions.
semantic_limits: Proof that a plot lies within a developer title is an identity/registration check only and cannot provide LiDAR raster provenance, terrain height or exact legal-boundary coordinates by itself.
